findings.message: This npm-capability gate lives in the `publish` job, so it fires only after the whole build has run and after a human has approved the `ts-sdk-npm-release` environment — and its remedy ("raise the node-version pin") requires editing the workflow and re-cutting the release. Since the two jobs pin the same `node-version`, run this check in `build` (or install an explicit `npm@>=11.15.0` here) so a stale pin fails before anyone is asked to approve a deployment.
